お互いの力を警戒してか、
大軍を動かすことは

事情が変わってまいりました。{0c:2b5409fe}

strings.en:
As you know,
{10}-dono, Eleanor-dono,{1a}perhaps because strategically vital roads
to Mibal, Talnas and Janan cross within
my lands,{1a}ever since the fall of the Kingdom of
Racoss our Aquine has been exposed to
invasion by its neighbors, and the land
only grows more desolate...{1a}Until now each nation, wary of the
others' strength, never moved a
great army,{1a}but with Morsans surrendering to Talnas
and Liemix surrendering to Gaste,
matters have changed.{0c:2b5409fe}
strings.tl: As you know, [HERO]-dono, Eleanor-dono, // perhaps because strategically vital roads to Mibal, Talnas and Janan cross within my lands, // ever since the fall of the Kingdom of Racoss our Aquine has been exposed to invasion by its neighbors, and the land only grows more desolate... // Until now each nation, wary of the others' strength, never moved a great army, // but with Morsans surrendering to Talnas and Liemix surrendering to Gaste, matters have changed.
Until then, the enemies who attacked our lands numbered two thousand at most, // but in the invasion by Talnas four months ago, a force of eighteen thousand in all...
On that occasion, thanks to the deeds of [HERO]-dono and Eleanor-dono, we were able to repel the enemy, but at the next invasion, who can say...

strings.en:
{0b:08}【 General Guyenne 】{0b:09}
Four months ago, when the combined
armies of Talnas and Morsans came upon
us, eighteen thousand strong,{1a}{0c:51b0}our troops numbered a mere eight
hundred, and my men and I had resigned
ourselves to death,{1a}but {10}-sama held the western
gorge single-handed,{1a}and Eleanor-sama, commanding peasant
soldiers without proper weapons, held
the seven eastern bridges to the last.{1a}By that one battle, {10}-sama
came to be feared by the enemy as the
'Devil of Aquine', and in our lands is called
the 'Holy Warrior of Aquine', revered by{1a}the people.{1a}Eleanor-sama, for her superb command,
and for the sure guidance of the
reconstruction plan she submitted after
the enemy withdrew,{1a}is renowned within the land and beyond
as the 'Wise Woman of the West'.{1a}Every soul in our lands is waiting for you
both to come down from this mountain.{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.tl: Four months ago, when the combined armies of Talnas and Morsans came upon us, eighteen thousand strong, // [1]our troops numbered a mere eight hundred, and my men and I had resigned ourselves to death, // but [HERO]-sama held the western gorge single-handed, // and Eleanor-sama, commanding peasant soldiers without proper weapons, held the seven eastern bridges to the last. // By that one battle, [HERO]-sama came to be feared by the enemy as the 'Devil of Aquine', and in our lands is called the 'Holy Warrior of Aquine', revered by the people. // Eleanor-sama, for her superb command, and for the sure guidance of the reconstruction plan she submitted after the enemy withdrew, // is renowned within the land and beyond as the 'Wise Woman of the West'. // Every soul in our lands is waiting for you both to come down from this mountain.
That was only to protect my home... // I wished only to protect the house where these orphans live.

No, I will follow your judgment. // [1]I live devoted to you, who gave me this happiness.
Tomorrow it will be exactly three years since we came down from that mountain.

将軍と大臣の位を用意して待ってる、

待ってるって言われたんだろ?{1a}ホワイトセイルの自由都市連合にも
招かれてるって聞いてた。
おそらくもっと色んな所から
招かれてるんだろう。{1a}まあ当然だ。

たった1人で千の敵を追い払って

用兵の才にも政治の才にも優れた才媛。{1a}諸侯共があんた達に
目を付けるのはもっともだ。

これが、俺の部下の間でも、
ロドリゴの部下の間でも
疑問になっている。{1a}{0c:5140}大変言いにくいんだが、

もらってるんじゃないかってな。{0c:2b5109fe}

strings.en:
{0b:08}【 Mercenary 】{0b:09}
It's why you two don't aim higher.{1a}I heard the King of Fakolz scouted you
in person.{1a}The King said he'd have a general's rank
and a minister's rank waiting, and one
castle each, right?{1a}I also heard the free city league of
Whitesail invited you. Probably plenty of
other places too.{1a}Well, it's only natural. One's the
legendary woman hero, who drove off a
thousand enemies single-handed at the
battle of Talebizan and got called a{1a}War God,{1a}the other's a brilliant woman, a common
mercenary, yet gifted at both command
and politics.{1a}No wonder the lords got their eye on
you. I'd do the same if I was a king.{1a}But why'd you turn 'em down... that's
what's puzzling my men, and
Rodrigo's too.{1a}{0c:5140}Hard to say this, but they figure you're
getting paid off under the table
by somebody.{0c:2b5109fe}

Wouldn't go so far as distrust.{1a}It's buried under flashy rumors, how you

strings.tl: Wouldn't go so far as distrust. // It's buried under flashy rumors, how you two drove off three thousand-plus enemies on your own, // but I also heard you talked the king who hired you out of collecting a war tax. // In our unit, where plenty of us come from farm villages, your reputation ain't bad at all. No, it's about the best we've seen. // So it ain't distrust, just a 'simple question'.
A childish reason, I am afraid. We dislike being part of an organization.
Now that's a surprise. // [HERO]-dono, maybe, but you'd look right at home in a place like that...
Those who stand above others in an organization must at times give unreasonable orders...
But this time you're the ones giving us orders, ain't ya. // And the duke who hired you might give you an unreasonable order too.
As mercenaries, we may refuse any order, so long as we return the contract money. // That too is an unwritten rule in the mercenary world, is it not?
For example, in a siege, to drain the enemy castle's food faster, // sometimes ya turn back the women and children trying to surrender. // [1]Say you got an order like that. What then?
I would end the contract. To begin with, I have never once taken work on the invading side.
Being that picky and still in such demand... // Damn, I gotta hand it to ya.
